profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at a360inc
profile.summary: Senior Backend PHP Developer with 12+ years building, modernizing, and scaling enterprise and SaaS applications, with recent full-stack work in React, TypeScript, and Next.js. I specialize in migrating legacy PHP systems to PHP 8.x, optimizing performance, and designing secure, maintainable APIs. I’ve served as a technical lead across multiple roles—driving architectural decisions, leading code migrations, mentoring developers, and shipping high-quality releases in Agile environments. I enjoy taking on legacy systems that need a clear path forward and turning them into something maintainable and fast. Core stack: PHP 7.x/8.x, Symfony, Laravel, React 18, Next.js 14, TypeScript, MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS & Azure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the migration of a large-scale enterprise application from PHP 5.6 to PHP 8.3, modernizing legacy logic and 
aligning the codebase with current standards and security practices.
- Sustained a mission-critical PHP/MySQL/Apache platform by resolving defects, optimizing slow queries, and 
shipping new backend features; standardized environments with Docker.
- Raised backend team productivity by standardizing workflows, coding practices, and tooling.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
- Cotributed to develop a SaaS application on PHP 7.x and Laravel, designing API endpoints and data-storage solutions that improved server response times.
- Reduced critical defects across company-wide SaaS applications through in-depth code reviews and root-cause analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Laravel · Vue.js · JavaScript · Docker · PhpStorm

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
- Optimized server-side applications in PHP 8 and MySQL for speed and scalability; refactored legacy codebases 
and contributed to architectural decisions.
- Mentored and onboarded new developers, accelerating team ramp-up.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Symfony Framework · React.js · Docker · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Back-end PHP Developer
positions.description:
- Led backend work on SaaS platforms, including large-scale code migrations, and improved performance through query optimization and caching.
- Provisioned multi-environment infrastructure with AWS CloudFormation (VPCs, EC2, S3, IAM, Security Groups) 
and designed APIs and database schemas.
positions.insights: Skills: LAMP · OOP · PHP · Containerization · Web Development · PHP Applications · SQL · MySQL · Doctrine · PostgreSQL · Symfony Framework · Linux · REST · MVC · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Symfony · Docker · Git · Apache · Web Applications · REST APIs · PHP Frameworks · Design Patterns

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented software solutions to optimize infrastructure performance while utilizing advanced analytics and automation tools to increase operational efficiency. Examined application needs and website requirements from teams and clients. Created client-specific interfaces, processes, and data analysis libraries using the most up-to-date technologies.
- Designed and delivered advanced software solutions by gathering and turning technical requirements into successful user stories in close liaison with the customer and internal software development teams.
- Liaised with the team members to understand client requirements; coordinated with the design team for the mockups and wireframes; deployed the latest features that facilitate the relevant tools and procedures.
- Developed and implemented the finest practices and standards for software creation and execution while ensuring adherence to industry and organizational guidelines as well as promoting continuous improvement and innovation.
positions.insights: Skills: LAMP · OOP · PHP · Containerization · Web Development · PHP Applications · SQL · MySQL · PostgreSQL · jQuery · Linux · MVC · Git · CodeIgniter · Apache · Web Applications · PHP Frameworks · Design Patterns

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.locationName: Boca Raton, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Employed coding standards and connected applications with third-party web services to improve functionality. Executed unit tests and assisted with problem resolution to ensure all components operated at maximum levels. Liaised with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and design more functional, cohesive codes, enhancing the user experience.
- Managed backups, redundancy, automation, environment setup, and various general tasks by developing a toolset of PHP scripts; configured and maintained PHP programming and development platform environments.
- Communicated task progress, assessments, ideas, and schedules, including technical and procedural challenges, effectively.
- Created and maintained cutting-edge web-based PHP apps on premium service platforms to ensure smooth operations.
- Automated validation and deployment of infrastructure templates using GitHub Actions, integrating linting (cfn-lint), syntax validation, and stack deployments.
- Managed source control operations using GitHub, including feature branching, pull request workflows, and semantic versioning.
- Maintained clean and secure CI/CD pipelines by configuring GitHub Secrets for credentials and environment variables.
- Created .gitignore files and comprehensive documentation (README.md) to support cross-team understanding of infrastructure setups and automation pipelines.
positions.insights: Skills: LAMP · OOP · PHP · Containerization · Web Development · PHP Applications · SQL · MySQL · Doctrine · PostgreSQL · jQuery · Linux · REST · MVC · Docker · Git · Apache · Web Applications · PHP Frameworks · Design Patterns

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Developed and implemented new functionalities for the in-house system. Designed and employed a SaaS application using PHP7+ and the company's in-house framework. Coordinated with diverse programming teams to prototype and solve complex business problems. 
- Directed the development of the product and concept of the brand-new idea of the application; integrated data from various back-end services and databases; created and analyzed reliable and secure back-end functionality.
- Achieved high application performance and customer appreciation; created new procedures for requirements gathering, needs analysis, testing, scripting, and documentation to strengthen the quality and functionality of critical applications.
- Offered technical guidance and recommendations for business decisions like performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
- Examined user and business requirements and functional specs to support application development and server optimization.
positions.insights: Skills: LAMP · OOP · PHP · Containerization · Web Development · PHP Applications · SQL · PostgreSQL · Linux · REST · MVC · Docker · Web Applications · PHP Frameworks · Design Patterns
